name: Aeon, Proskilisi
body:
Aeon, Proskilisi
CR 5/MR 2

XP 1,600
N Fine outsider (extraplanar, incorporeal, mythic)
Init +7; Senses thoughtsight 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 26, flat-footed 23 (+5 deflection, +3 Dex, +8 size)
hp 42 (4d10+20)
Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +5
Immune cold, critical hits, incorporeal traits, poison; Resist electricity 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee incorporeal touch +15 (1d6 force plus bond)
Space 1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks bond, mythic power (1/day, surge +1d6)

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 17, Con 10, Int 15, Wis 12, Cha 16
Base Atk +4; CMB –4; CMD 14
Feats Improved Initiative, Skill Focus M (Knowledge (any one))
Skills Fly +18, Knowledge (any one) +14, Knowledge (any four) +11, Perception +8, Stealth +26
Languages envisaging
SQ cosmic radiance, effect extension, extension of all, host, sensory extension

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bond (Su)

As a standard action or as part of its touch attack, a proskilisi can bond to any creature it makes a successful melee touch attack against. The target must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or become bonded to the proskilisi. While bonded, the proskilisi loses its own form, merging with the bonded creature and enabling its effect extension and sensory extension abilities to be used through the bonded creature. The bonded creature controls all of its own actions as normal, though the proskilisi may still cast spells and manifest powers using its own actions. A proskilisi can end a bond at any time as a free action.

Cosmic Radiance (Su)

A proskilisi sheds light as a torch out to 30 feet.

Effect Extension (Su)

A proskilisi’s zenith aeon host is capable of manifesting any power it can manifest or casting any spell it can cast using the proskilisi as the point of origin (this includes affecting the proskilisi with abilities which would have a target of personal). This ability extends to any creature which the proskilisi is bonded to.

Host (Su)

Every proskilisi has a zenith host, a zenith aeon which created it. A proskilisi can communicate with its host from any distance, and as a full-round action can merge with it once again from any distance (including across planes).

Sensory Extension (Su)

A proskilisi’s zenith aeon host is capable of sensing through the proskilisi’s position using its own senses. If the proskilisi is bonded to a creature, the zenith host is capable of sensing through that creature’s position and that creature’s senses as well.

ABOUT

Detached from its larger zenith colony, this barely perceptible mote floats with ease and precision through any surface. When bonded to a creature, a proskilisi manifests as a faint light and guiding voice. Even these small geometric agents host the wisdom of many lifetimes and worlds, and while they lack their own magical capacity they are capable of endowing their chosen hosts with the power of an entire zenith.
